connector.name: Kalender Sync
connector.registryDescription: GDPR-compliant calendar access for AI assistants. Google, Microsoft 365, Apple & more. EU-hosted.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.kalender-sync.de over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace de.kalender-sync, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token minted in the app under Settings → AI assistant (format: 'Bearer <token>'). Clients that support MCP OAuth can connect without this header — the server offers a built-in OAuth flow.
